comparison_protocol.camera_agreement_metric: Relative rotation angle error (degrees) and translation vector angular error
comparison_protocol.point_cloud_alignment: Iterative Closest Point (ICP) fitness score and Chamfer distance
comparison_protocol.reprojection_error_metric: Mean and Root-Mean-Square Error (RMSE) in pixels over verified SIFT/dense inliers
comparison_protocol.scale_relationship: Relative uncalibrated baseline (DUSt3R/MASt3R/COLMAP) vs metric prior (RGB-D)
comparison_protocol.disagreement_resolution: Observation confidence weighting: MASt3R/COLMAP high-confidence inliers strictly anchor geometry; generative priors are rejected if residual > 3.0px

VGGT.role: Rapid joint multi-view pose & point map prediction
VGGT.output_type: Dense Point Map (N, H, W, 3) + Camera Poses

DUSt3R.role: Dense unconstrained stereo geometry & pairwise alignment
DUSt3R.strengths: No camera calibration required upfront, dense coverage
DUSt3R.weaknesses: Pairwise drift on long loops without global alignment

MASt3R.output_type: 3D Feature Descriptors + Dense Matches + Metric Confidence
MASt3R.strengths: Sub-pixel correspondence precision, high robustness on low-texture surfaces
MASt3R.weaknesses: Higher computational footprint per image pair

COLMAP.role: Classical sparse Structure from Motion & Bundle Adjustment
COLMAP.output_type: Calibrated Pinhole Cameras + Sparse Triangulated Points (V, 3)
COLMAP.scale: Relative (Metric if scaled by known baseline)
COLMAP.strengths: Strict mathematical consistency, lowest reprojection error (<0.8px)
COLMAP.weaknesses: Fails on untextured/specular surfaces, non-feedforward optimization
